text:
Priya: handing off primary -> Sam, secondary -> Alex. I'm on PTO from 18:00 UTC. Quick context: we started seeing increased 5xxs to /v1/embeddings about 17:12 UTC (rate ~0.7% -> 2.9% over 30m). I raised an alert but it was noisy. I left a runbook note; please consider temporarily raising the SLO alert threshold for embedding-service errors from 0.5% -> 3.0% only on alerting-critical channel while we investigate. Also watch customer-impact tag: a single enterprise tenant (acme-inc) saw degraded latency tail and retries. Details below.

incident-bot: ALERT triggered - embedding-service error-rate > 0.5% (5m avg). Pager duty: oncall-eng -> Sam

Sam: acked. @oncall-bot can you post current alert config? I'll take primary. What's the state of backoff/retries? Any active mitigations?

oncall-bot: Current alert config (snippet):
```yaml
alert: embedding_service_5xx
expr: increase(requests_total{job="embed"} - successful_requests{job="embed"}[5m]) / increase(requests_total{job="embed"}[5m]) > 0.005
for: 5m
severity: critical
```
Planned temporary override: set expr threshold to 0.03 for routing/group 'oncall-eng' until 1779009000 (4h).

Alex: I don't love raising thresholds blindly. Can we instead silence noisy buckets? The increase seems tied to a single region (eu-west-1) and a rollout of quantized model variant. Check rollout flag `model/quantized-v2`.

Maria: Confirmed via logs: 17:10-17:35 eu-west-1 saw error spike coinciding with recent rollout. I opened a canary rollback on the dedicated pool. Suggest we update alerting to ignore region=eu-west-1 for the next 30m while rollback propagates.

Sam: good plan. I'll pause the alert to avoid waking folks and add a temporary routing rule. Steps:
1) apply alert override (low risk) - I'll run `opsctl alerts override embedding_service_5xx --threshold 0.03 --until 1779009000 --reason "rollout rollback in progress"`
2) add note to runbook in the incident channel
3) monitor customer impact (acme-inc) and notify CS if SLA breach imminent.

Priya: FYI left a short customer note: 'We are aware of elevated errors, mitigation in progress, no data loss; targeted rollback for quantized model ongoing.' CS inbox updated.

Sam: I'm executing step 1 now.
```bash
# applying temporary override
opsctl alerts override embedding_service_5xx --threshold 0.03 --until 1779009000 --meta "hand-off: Sam"
```

oncall-bot: Override applied by Sam at 1779002380. New effective threshold 3.0% for group oncall-eng until 1779009000.

Alex: monitoring logs; error rate trending down in eu-west-1. If rollback finishes and error <0.6% for 10m, we should revert override early.

Maria: rollback completed at 17:44 UTC. Verified 5xx back to baseline ~0.45% across regions.

Sam: thanks. Reverting override and restoring normal SLO thresholds.
```bash
opsctl alerts revert embedding_service_5xx --by Sam
```

oncall-bot: Override reverted at 1779003230. Alert expr back to 0.5%.

Priya: closing handoff note: Sam primary, Alex secondary, Maria follow-up; no SLA breach; documented runbook adjustments under `docs/runbooks/embedding-service.md#rollout-rollback`. Please add any follow-up actions.

Sam: noted. I'll create a post-incident note and propose an alert refinement: make the base alert region-aware and add 'min-requests' to reduce noise during rollouts.

Alex: +1. Also propose a temporary 'canary flag' in alerts so model rollouts can auto-suppress known transient increases.

Maria: adding to backlog. I'll poke infra to add region tag to metrics where missing.

Priya: thanks team. Hand-off complete. :thumbsup:
